transactions.description: Mark Thompson responds to Frank Russo's outreach and arranges a coffee meeting. Peer relationship-building between two vehicle-sector educators watching the same AV disruption. Mark listens first, floats the idea of Frank's driving school as a complementary feeder into the Auto Tech Pipeline.

resources.detail: Mutual professional time exchanged. Low cost, relationship-building orientation.

transactions.expected_outcome: Increased trust with driving_instructor. Potential future coalition ally for pipeline proposal and grant political support. No immediate financial effect.

transactions.description: Mark Thompson sends a one-page follow-up memo to Councilmember Maria Santos's office referencing the 12 retraining enrollments and rising unemployment data as real-time validation of the Auto Tech Pipeline demand projections. Reinforces the existing grant and endorsement ask without making a new one.

resources.detail: One hour of Mark's professional time to draft and send the memo.

transactions.expected_outcome: Keeps the pipeline proposal visible and data-backed in Santos's office. Strengthens the grant application case. No immediate financial effect.
